name: video_audio_isolate
description: Separates one described sound out of a clip's audio — `prompt` names what to keep, e.g. "the voice", "the guitar", "traffic noise". The clip must already have an audio track. Removing background noise from a standalone audio file → `audio_isolate`. Requires a paid plan. Then `creations_show`.

creationIdentifier.description: Completed owned video creation that has an audio track.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

prompt.description: What to isolate, e.g. "the speaker's voice" or "the music".

trimSeconds.description: Optional: process only this window instead of the whole clip.
